steps: Sign in to the Cloudflare dashboard; this is My Profile → API Tokens
Click 'Create Token' and pick a template (e.g. 'Edit zone DNS') or 'Create Custom Token'
Set the permissions and the zone/account resources, then 'Continue to summary' → 'Create Token'
Copy the token — it is shown exactly once
Tokens made for an account (not for you personally) are checked at a different address; if the check says the token is wrong but you just made it, test it with Cloudflare's own docs
unverified: validate.url (works for user tokens; account-owned tokens use accounts/{id}/tokens/verify)

least_privilege.summary: Use a template or custom token limited to one zone and only the permissions you need - never the Global API Key.
